children: European natural gas prices fell 7% to €74 per megawatt-hour, the lowest in two weeks, after details of Germany’s latest gas storage tenders indicated lower volumes than initially expected.
Trading Hub Europe launched several tenders to secure sufficient gas availability for the first quarter of 2027, amid concerns over storage levels ahead of winter.
Also, weather forecasts point to a late-summer heat spell next week, with temperatures across Northwest Europe expected to rise around 6°C above normal, potentially reducing gas demand.
Additionally, President Donald Trump signaled that US-Iran diplomacy could resume, including the possibility of meeting Iran’s president during the UN General Assembly in New York.
Progress toward ending the conflict could reduce concerns about potential disruptions to energy flows through the Strait of Hormuz, an important route for global LNG shipments.

title: European Natural Gas Prices Slump 7%
